summary.tldr: Requires health information technology vendors to make their systems interoperable and stops data blocking.
what_it_does: Requires health information technology that is licensed, sold, or supplied as a service to be interoperable, meaning it can work with other systems.
Prohibits data blocking by health information technology vendors.
Aims to support a connected, secure, and person-centred health system.
summary.background: Bill C-72 was introduced in the House of Commons on 6 June 2024 and received first reading.
